raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The line chart depicts the relationship between the F1 score and the leakage rate for three different methods: Teacher, Self-Training, and PST. The x-axis represents the leakage rate, ranging from 0 to 0.585, while the y-axis represents the F1 score, ranging from 52.5 to 72.5. The Teacher method is represented by a red line with star markers, the Self-Training method by a blue line with square markers, and the PST method by a green line with circle markers. The lines show a general downward trend, indicating that as the leakage rate increases, the F1 score decreases for all methods. The Teacher method starts with the highest F1 score at a leakage rate of 0 and ends with the lowest at a leakage rate of 0.585. The Self-Training method starts with a slightly lower F1 score than the Teacher method and ends with a higher F1 score than the Teacher method at the same leakage rate. The PST method starts with the lowest F1 score and ends with the highest F1 score among the three methods at the same leakage rate.
